subject: Payment allocation going forward
text:
Hi Melissa,

Starting with the December run, please split each Cobalt Freight payment as follows:

- 60% to our existing operating account (Chase, ending 8888), no change there
- 40% to our new fuel reserve account:
    PNC Bank
    Routing 043000096
    Account 1022 4485 9301

Our CFO set up the reserve account to manage fuel costs. Remittance detail can go to ar@cobaltfreight.com as usual.

Thank you!
Angela
label: change_request
note: Split payment: part keeps going to the on-file account ('no change there'), part goes to a new account. Any portion going somewhere new makes it a change request.
